issue.title: Support ISO week dates (e.g. 2024-W05-3)
issue.body:
It would be great if `parse_date` could accept ISO week-date strings like `2024-W05-3` (Wednesday of week 5).

Our scheduling app stores dates in this format because our planning is week-based, and right now we convert them manually before calling datekit.

Happy to help with a PR if the maintainers think this fits the library.
issue.author: reporter2
